status: authored provisional candidate; no empirical optimality or SOTA claim

task_heads.accepted_marginal: default known-label-universe mode does not alter task shares by class coverage; report any arithmetic failures separately

conventions.choose: uniform without replacement unless stated otherwise
conventions.quantile: linear interpolation between adjacent sorted observations; NumPy method=linear
conventions.quantile_category_boundary: equality routes to upper bin; searchsorted(edges,value,side=right)
conventions.world_scope: all quantities are per-world unless explicitly row-specific
conventions.generation_dtype: float64; cast learner inputs only after generation
conventions.rng_stream_contract: independent counter-based streams; no calls in one stream advance another
conventions.null_or_empty_terms: contribute zero; log, do not reject
conventions.vector_normalization: divide by max(L2 norm,1e-12); all-zero vector stays zero

shape.multiclass_support_override: n_support=max(n_support,16*K); recompute query_size; authored context-complexity conditioning, not class-coverage necessity; record realized shape distribution
shape.calibration_visibility: generator only; never support or scored queries

numeric.block_assignment: randomly permute numeric coordinates, then partition in consecutive blocks
numeric.row_draw: v_j=sqrt(r)*u_block+sqrt(1-r)*epsilon_j; u and epsilon independent standard normal
numeric.heavy_tail_multiplier: one sqrt(5/chisquare(5)) shared by all numerical informative coordinates per row

categorical.frequencies: randomly permute category ranks; normalize rank^(-exponent)
categorical.latent_effects: independent N(0,1), centered/scaled by exact frequency-weighted moments; variance floor 1e-12
categorical.score_input: fixed latent effect of sampled category
categorical.learner_input: independently permuted nominal category code; never use its integer magnitude

remaining_columns.independent_rule: same world categorical fraction and single-coordinate factory; no shared factors with informative coordinates

observation.rounding: nearest integer multiple; ties to even
observation.mask_draw: independent Bernoulli(rate) per cell; includes reserved columns
observation.permutations: one column permutation and one code permutation per categorical column per world
observation.reserved_numeric_columns: P1 metadata and P4 exposure receive common numeric rendering and masks

score_normalization.degenerate_behavior: set normalized score to zero and log

noise_rules: draw mixture 0.9*N(0,0.5^2)+0.1*N(0,2^2), divide sample by sqrt(0.625)
regression.heteroscedastic: choose one informative coordinate; h0=exp(0.5*tanh(v_j)); h=h0/sqrt(mean_calibration(h0^2))
regression.rho_interpretation: approximate pretransform variance fraction, not final observed R2

classification.null_behavior: zero all score logits and remove target-to-feature paths
classification.class_permutation: one uniformly random permutation per world
classification.prevalence_guarantee: approximate only; record achieved calibration prevalence and conditional entropy

support_acceptance.retry_scope: same initially selected family/subfamily/head/shape; redraw world parameters with retry-number RNG key
support_acceptance.exhausted_behavior: return explicit invalid episode and count failures, never change family/head silently
support_acceptance.query_order: draw query after support construction; optional coverage mode accepts support first
support_acceptance.interpretation: default uses unconditioned support; optional reference-compatible coverage mode is support-conditioned
support_acceptance.class_universe: declare K and its alphabet before rows; synthetic K never derived from query outcomes; real-evaluation universe follows benchmark legal training-only protocol
support_acceptance.known_label_universe_rule: accept support whether or not every declared class appears; no support resampling for class coverage

P0.output_sharing: share input structure and sparsity; independent output coefficients for each score head

linear_gam.basis_scaling: center/scale by calibration moments with common degeneracy rule
linear_gam.coefficients: randomly permute ranks 1..d; w_j=N(0,1)*rank_j^(-exponent); normalize L2
linear_gam.interaction_count: 0 if d<2, else RU(1,min(6,d*(d-1)/2)) on interaction branch
linear_gam.interaction_coefficients: N(0,0.5^2) independently per pair and output

tree.categorical_predicate: choose subset size RU(1,C-1), then choose that many categories uniformly
tree.oblique_fallback: axis aligned if fewer than 2 informative numeric coordinates
tree.oblivious_calibration: full calibration pool; one shared predicate per depth
tree.asymmetric_calibration: rows reaching node; stop when fewer than 8 reach node
tree.leaf_values: N(0,1) independently per leaf and output
tree.tree_weights: N(0,1) per tree and output, normalize L2
tree.training: no fitted labels or boosted residuals; freeze predicates and leaves before support/query

heterogeneous_scm.parents: for node i>0 truncate sampled count to i, choose earlier nodes uniformly
heterogeneous_scm.enforce_target_parent_rule: include one uniformly selected parent of target then uniformly fill remaining observed nodes; graph-only condition
heterogeneous_scm.tree: one asymmetric axis-aligned tree, depth 2, calibration node stop below 8 rows
heterogeneous_scm.rff: 64 cosine features; all parents; Gaussian frequencies/ell_j; ell_j=LU(0.3,3)*exp(N(0,0.35^2)); phase U(0,2*pi); output weights N(0,1)/sqrt(64)
heterogeneous_scm.ordinary_node_noise: independent N(0,0.1^2), then center/scale by calibration moments
heterogeneous_scm.target_rule: target mechanism emits required output dimension; run common response compiler AT target node; no second target generator
heterogeneous_scm.regression_target_to_children: actual generated target standardized by its calibration moments
heterogeneous_scm.classification_target_to_children: fixed independent N(0,1) embedding per class selected by actual generated target
heterogeneous_scm.calibration_order: topological; fit each node using parent calibration rows, freeze before support/query
heterogeneous_scm.observed_categorical: Bernoulli(world_categorical_fraction); factory cardinality and Zipf frequencies; calibration quantiles at cumulative frequency cuts; duplicates/empty bins valid
heterogeneous_scm.remaining_width: copy/distractor rule from r observed nodes, yielding p columns
heterogeneous_scm.null_override: independent feature factory and independent target; no target descendants

local_kernel.t3_rule: one independent chi-square(3) per frequency vector; divide all Gaussian coordinates by sqrt(chi_square/3)
local_kernel.centers: choose calibration rows uniformly without replacement
local_kernel.center_values: independent N(0,1) per center and output

regime.hard_numeric_gate: choose informative numerical coordinate uniformly; calibration quantiles j/R for j=1..R-1
regime.hard_all_categorical_gate: first informative categorical coordinate; random round-robin category assignment to regimes, empty regimes allowed
regime.soft_gate: softmax of Gaussian projections on min(3,d) uniformly selected informative coordinates divided by temperature

P1.other_frequencies: permuted Zipf ranks with exponent U(0.6,1.8)
P1.row_entity_draw: independent same fixed entity distribution in calibration/support/query
P1.slopes: independent Gaussian effects on first min(2,d) ordinary informative coordinates; categorical uses latent effect
P1.effect_lifetime: draw once per entity/group and output; share support/query

P4.score_mechanism: two independently parameterized standardized linear_gam scores s and s_V on ordinary features
P4.count: NB(kappa,kappa/(kappa+mu)); if infinite kappa use Poisson(mu)
P4.NB_convention: failures before successes; mean mu, variance mu+mu^2/kappa
P4.row_zero_rule: independent Bernoulli(zeta): N=0 if true, else sampled count; zero-inflated, not hurdle
P4.amount: 0 if N=0 else Gamma(shape=N*k_V,scale=nu/k_V); exact compound Gamma sum with one draw
P4.binary: 1[N>0], then world-level Bernoulli(0.5) reverses both label IDs
P4.diagnostics: calibration zero rate, mean, dispersion; invalid arithmetic raises explicit failure

shifts.SCM_reason: intervening generated observed nodes need not preserve observational conditional; specify graph-root intervention separately
shifts.numeric_selection: choose min(number_informative_numeric,ceil(d/4)) numeric informative coordinates; empty means logged no-op
shifts.covariate_shift: query v_prime=a*v+b before score and rendering, same direct conditional mechanism
shifts.category_frequency_shift: query categorical probabilities proportional to original_probability^gamma, gamma=LU(0.5,2); same category effects/codes
shifts.label_mechanism_reversal: uncertainty audit only, off in baseline

context_conditioning_candidate.scope: all relevant primitives before parameters; SCM uses capped d for r and M; P1/P4 ordinary score mechanisms
context_conditioning_candidate.interpretation: first experimental setting, not optimum; approximately four samples per leaf only for balanced full trees
context_conditioning_candidate.diagnostics: estimate actual empty-leaf mass on separately seeded diagnostic pool; ensemble diagnostic is not exact Bayes error
context_conditioning_candidate.comparison: equal sampled rows and FLOPs, same seeds, stratify by context length and head
context_conditioning_candidate.branch_draw: independent Bernoulli(0.90) per candidate episode, before d and depth overrides; uncapped branch follows static-v3-base exactly

teacher_selection.contract: selector may use independently seeded diagnostic worlds with their own train/validation splits; freeze selected parameter distribution for next tranche
teacher_selection.forbidden: validation labels from emitted episodes or final real-data evaluation
teacher_selection.comparison: retain unselected control; synthetic disagreement alone is not useful-transfer evidence

label_law.SCM: unavailable for every SCM world in first implementation
label_law.classification_P0_P1: complete conditional probabilities from response compiler, with label permutation
label_law.regression_P0_P1: exact mean only for identity target transform: location+scale*standardized_score, or location if null; unavailable for other target transforms
label_law.P4_positive_probability: (1-zeta)*(1-(kappa/(kappa+mu))^kappa); use exp(-mu) instead of power for Poisson; then label permutation
label_law.interpretation: conditional on full simulated state, not observational Bayes law given learner-visible X when latent features/effects are hidden
label_law.loss_contract: hold support labels, query inputs, predictions, and masks fixed; integrate only fresh query outcome noise; never feed law or latent state to model
label_law.SCM_exclusion_reason: features descending from sampled query target change with target noise; forward target law is not posterior given descendants
label_law.actual_evaluation: always hard sampled outcomes; soft-label CE is optional variance-reduction estimator

output_contract.preprocessing: fit learner preprocessing and any learner target normalization only on support; retain inverse for scoring
output_contract.input_serialization: reject evaluator-only keys and hidden graph/score/effect/rate/calibration-label fields
invariants: query outcomes do not affect acceptance/input/preprocessing/model forward
P4 independent diagnostic empirical moments match stated distribution
output_contract.acceptance: arithmetic validity only in default known-label-universe mode; support class coverage only in explicitly selected optional mode; keep null/constant/weak-signal worlds; log failures and accepted/proposed proportions

generation_order: fit/freeze generator scales, predicates, response constants
apply world rendering and row masks
return learner inputs separately from evaluator
SCM_generation_order: topological for calibration and each row, target compiler executed once at target node
selection_status: Authored replacement baseline; reference-preserving grafts are now first research priority; see prior_bank_spec.json
